blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber

{"content":"# Thread 3 — IMPORTANT: near-duplicate head-repo resolvers

Fixed with the "better" option from the thread: one resolver, one implementation.

- `js/common/smProvider.js` exports `ghPrHeadRepoFull` (the module already had an exports block; the export is added there with a comment pinning the shared-contract rationale).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` `_prItemFromPr` consumes `smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p)`; the local `_prListHeadRepo` duplicate is deleted.

Both payload dialects (REST PR-list entries and the `prStatus` body) are now resolved by the same function, so the `nameWithOwner` drift called out in the thread cannot recur. The narrower-than-the-description claim is now pinned at the exact function where the behavior lives.

{"content":"# Thread 1 — BLOCKING: `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` CRAP 13.8 > 8

Fixed in `js/common/smProvider.js` (rework commits `42388320` + `37426a2c`).

The monolithic resolver was split following the suggested shape, one step further so every piece sits well under the gate:

- `_ghRepoOwnerLogin(repo)` — the owner-login (`login`/`name`) resolution, complexity 5.
- `_ghRepoShapeFull(r)` — the object-shaped dialects (`full_name`, `nameWithOwner`, owner+name), complexity 5.
- `_ghPrHeadRepoFull(pr)` — the entry point (null guard + string dialect + delegate), complexity 6.

The resolver is now exported as `ghPrHeadRepoFull` and is the **single** implementation consumed by both `smProvider.js` (`prStatus.headRepo`) and `githubSource.js` (`_prItemFromPr`) — see thread 3.

Re-measured locally with the pinned `crap4js@83ee6201` over the nyc-instrumented tree (same pipeline as the CI `crap` job):

```text
_ghPrHeadRepoFull   js/common/smProvider.js   6   100.0%   6.0   (was 13.8)
_ghRepoShapeFull    js/common/smProvider.js   5   100.0%   5.0
_ghRepoOwnerLogin   js/common/smProvider.js   5    75.0%   5.4
```

Branch-covering tests added in `js/unit-tests/test_smProvider.js` — "github: the shared head-repo resolver covers every head.repo dialect (gh-1059)": string `head.repo` valid/invalid, `nameWithOwner`, `owner.login`+`name`, `owner.name` (no login), owner with neither, missing repo name, null/headless PR. RED first: the test failed on `ghPrHeadRepoFull` being unexported, then passed after the change.

{"content":"# Thread 2 — BLOCKING: `_prListHeadRepo` CRAP 22.4 > 8

Fixed by deletion: `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` no longer carries its own resolver. `_prItemFromPr` now calls the single shared resolver exported from `smProvider.js`:

```javascript
headRepo: smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p),
```

(`githubSource.js` already required `../../common/smProvider.js` at the top, so no new require surface; gh-823 hoisting rule respected.)

That removes the 22.4-CRAP function from the measured surface entirely and — because the shared resolver accepts every dialect the old pair covered (`full_name`, `nameWithOwner`, owner+name, string) — it also fixes the uncovered-branch gap the thread called out: the previously untested string / owner+name shapes are now exercised in one place. New integration coverage in `js/unit-tests/test_smGithubSource.js` — "gh-1059: STRING and GraphQL head.repo spellings ride the item via the shared resolver" — proves a string `head.repo` and a GraphQL `nameWithOwner` payload both reach the item and the bench oracle. All test mocks that stub the smProvider require now pin the **real** exported resolver instead of a forked copy.
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"# Thread 3 — IMPORTANT: near-duplicate head-repo resolvers

Fixed with the "better" option from the thread: one resolver, one implementation.

- `js/common/smProvider.js` exports `ghPrHeadRepoFull` (the module already had an exports block; the export is added there with a comment pinning the shared-contract rationale).
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` `_prItemFromPr` consumes `smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p)`; the local `_prListHeadRepo` duplicate is deleted.

Both payload dialects (REST PR-list entries and the `prStatus` body) are now resolved by the same function, so the `nameWithOwner` drift called out in the thread cannot recur. To keep the test suite honest, every mock that feeds `githubSource.js` (in `test_smGithubSource.js`, `test_smAgent.js`, `test_mergeCadence.js`) now injects the real exported resolver rather than silently omitting it — the gh-1059 integration test fails if the wiring regresses.
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3.md"}

{"content":"# Thread 4 — SUGGESTION: `_ghBranchExistsRef` at CRAP 8.0 + silent-bench note

Both points addressed in `js/common/smProvider.js`:

1. **Headroom.** The owner-parse complexity moved out of this area entirely — it now lives in the shared `_ghRepoOwnerLogin`/`_ghRepoShapeFull` helpers (CRAP 5.4 / 5.0), so `_ghBranchExistsRef` keeps only the redirect decision. It re-measures at complexity 8 with 100% coverage (CRAP 8.0, still passing), and future edits here are now smaller-surface: a new branch on the redirect no longer drags resolver dialect logic with it.

2. **Fail-open semantics documented.** The comment block on `_ghBranchExistsRef` now states explicitly that a fork the token cannot read (private fork) fails the probe exactly like a deleted branch — `branchHead` reads a probe error as absent — so an unreadable fork reads as a dead head and the parked PR is benched; and that this matches pre-gh-1057 fork behavior, with the githubSource `catch` only rescuing a *throwing* oracle. The narrower-than-the-description claim is now pinned at the exact function where the behavior lives.

# Rework — gh-1057 fork-blind dead-head park (PR #1059)

All four open review threads addressed: the two BLOCKING CRAP-gate failures and the IMPORTANT duplication are fixed by one shared resolver; the SUGGESTION's doc note is pinned at the exact function.

## Issues/Notes

- 🚨 `crap` quality gate (exit 2): `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` CRAP 13.8 and `_prListHeadRepo` CRAP 22.4 — both new functions over the threshold of 8, too complex to rescue with coverage alone.
- ⚠️ The two resolvers were near-duplicates already drifting (`nameWithOwner` only in one copy; different branch coverage in each).
- 💡 `_ghBranchExistsRef` sat at exactly CRAP 8.0, and the unreadable-fork-reads-as-dead-head semantics were undocumented.
- No merge conflicts, no other CI failures. The fix is pushed on the PR branch (`ai/gh-1057`, commits `42388320` + `37426a2c`).

## Approach

**One shared head-repo resolver (threads 1–3, single move as suggested):**

- `js/common/smProvider.js`
  - Split the monolithic `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` into three small pieces: `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` (entry: null guard + string dialect + delegate, complexity 6), `_ghRepoShapeFull` (object dialects `full_name` / `nameWithOwner` / owner+name, complexity 5), `_ghRepoOwnerLogin` (`login`/`name` owner resolution, complexity 5).
  - Exported the resolver as `ghPrHeadRepoFull` in the existing `module.exports` block.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`
  - Deleted the duplicate `_prListHeadRepo`; `_prItemFromPr` now calls `smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p)` through the require that was already at the top of the file (gh-823 hoisting respected — no new/deferred require).

**Thread 4:** `_ghBranchExistsRef` keeps its compact redirect (re-measures at CRAP 8.0, 100% coverage, passing), and its comment block now documents that an unreadable (private) fork reads as a dead head — probe error → absent → benched — matching pre-gh-1057 fork behavior, with the githubSource `catch` only rescuing a throwing oracle.

**Local gate verification** (same pipeline as the CI `crap` job — nyc-instrumented tree, pinned `crap4js@83ee6201`):

```text
_ghPrHeadRepoFull   js/common/smProvider.js   6   100.0%   6.0   (was 13.8)
_ghRepoShapeFull    js/common/smProvider.js   5   100.0%   5.0   (new helper)
_ghRepoOwnerLogin   js/common/smProvider.js   5    75.0%   5.4   (new helper)
_ghBranchExistsRef  js/common/smProvider.js   8   100.0%   8.0   (unchanged, passes)
_prListHeadRepo     — deleted from githubSource.js (was 22.4)
```

## Files Modified

- `js/common/smProvider.js` — resolver split into `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` / `_ghRepoShapeFull` / `_ghRepoOwnerLogin`; `ghPrHeadRepoFull` exported; fail-open doc line on `_ghBranchExistsRef`.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — `_prListHeadRepo` deleted; `_prItemFromPr` consumes the shared resolver.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smProvider.js` — new dialect-coverage test for the shared resolver (string valid/invalid, `nameWithOwner`, `owner.login`+`name`, `owner.name`, owner-less, name-less, null/headless PR).
- `js/unit-tests/test_smGithubSource.js` — mocks pin the real exported resolver (never a forked copy); new integration test: string and GraphQL `head.repo` spellings ride the item and reach the bench oracle.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js`, `js/unit-tests/test_mergeCadence.js` — smProvider mocks extended with the real `ghPrHeadRepoFull` (they load `githubSource.js`).

## Test Coverage

- TDD: the new `test_smProvider.js` dialect test was RED first (`ghPrHeadRepoFull` unexported → `undefined`), GREEN after the export/split.
- `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` (canonical runner): **4342 passed, 0 failed**.
- Node harness over the nyc-instrumented tree (the coverage vehicle of the `crap` job): **4342 passed, 0 failed**, coverage dumped for the ratchet re-measurement above.
- gh-1057 behavior unchanged: fork redirect, same-repo/malformed fail-safe, deleted-fork null → base probe, throwing-oracle fail-open — all still covered by the pre-existing gh-1057/gh-922 tests (all green).

{"content":"# Thread 1 — BLOCKING: `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` CRAP 13.8 > 8

- `_ghRepoOwnerLogin(repo)` — the owner-login (`login`/`name`) resolution, complexity 5.
- `_ghRepoShapeFull(r)` — the object-shaped dialects (`full_name`, `nameWithOwner`, owner+name), complexity 5.
- `_ghPrHeadRepoFull(pr)` — the entry point (null guard + string dialect + delegate), complexity 6.

The resolver is now exported as `ghPrHeadRepoFull` and is the **single** implementation consumed by both `smProvider.js` (`prStatus.headRepo`) and `githubSource.js` (`_prItemFromPr`) — see thread 3.

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1057 fork-blind dead-head park (PR #1059)

All four open review threads addressed: the two BLOCKING CRAP-gate failures and the IMPORTANT duplication are fixed by one shared resolver; the SUGGESTION's doc note is pinned at the exact function.

## Issues/Notes

- 🚨 `crap` quality gate (exit 2): `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` CRAP 13.8 and `_prListHeadRepo` CRAP 22.4 — both new functions over the threshold of 8, too complex to rescue with coverage alone.
- ⚠️ The two resolvers were near-duplicates already drifting (`nameWithOwner` only in one copy; different branch coverage in each).
- 💡 `_ghBranchExistsRef` sat at exactly CRAP 8.0, and the unreadable-fork-reads-as-dead-head semantics were undocumented.
- No merge conflicts, no other CI failures. The fix is pushed on the PR branch (`ai/gh-1057`, commits `42388320` + `37426a2c`).

## Approach

**One shared head-repo resolver (threads 1–3, single move as suggested):**

- `js/common/smProvider.js`
  - Split the monolithic `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` into three small pieces: `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` (entry: null guard + string dialect + delegate, complexity 6), `_ghRepoShapeFull` (object dialects `full_name` / `nameWithOwner` / owner+name, complexity 5), `_ghRepoOwnerLogin` (`login`/`name` owner resolution, complexity 5).
  - Exported the resolver as `ghPrHeadRepoFull` in the existing `module.exports` block.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`
  - Deleted the duplicate `_prListHeadRepo`; `_prItemFromPr` now calls `smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p)` through the require that was already at the top of the file (gh-823 hoisting respected — no new/deferred require).

**Thread 4:** `_ghBranchExistsRef` keeps its compact redirect (re-measures at CRAP 8.0, 100% coverage, passing), and its comment block now documents that an unreadable (private) fork reads as a dead head — probe error → absent → benched — matching pre-gh-1057 fork behavior, with the githubSource `catch` only rescuing a throwing oracle.

**Local gate verification** (same pipeline as the CI `crap` job — nyc-instrumented tree, pinned `crap4js@83ee6201`):

```text
_ghPrHeadRepoFull   js/common/smProvider.js   6   100.0%   6.0   (was 13.8)
_ghRepoShapeFull    js/common/smProvider.js   5   100.0%   5.0   (new helper)

_ghBranchExistsRef  js/common/smProvider.js   8   100.0%   8.0   (unchanged, passes)
_prListHeadRepo     — deleted from githubSource.js (was 22.4)
```

## Files Modified

- `js/common/smProvider.js` — resolver split into `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` / `_ghRepoShapeFull` / `_ghRepoOwnerLogin`; `ghPrHeadRepoFull` exported; fail-open doc line on `_ghBranchExistsRef`.

- `js/unit-tests/test_smGithubSource.js` — mocks pin the real exported resolver (never a forked copy); new integration test: string and GraphQL `head.repo` spellings ride the item and reach the bench oracle.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js`, `js/unit-tests/test_mergeCadence.js` — smProvider mocks extended with the real `ghPrHeadRepoFull` (they load `githubSource.js`).

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1057 fork-blind dead-head park (PR #1059)

All four open review threads addressed: the two BLOCKING CRAP-gate failures and the IMPORTANT duplication are fixed by one shared resolver; the SUGGESTION's doc note is pinned at the exact function.

## Issues/Notes

- 🚨 `crap` quality gate (exit 2): `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` CRAP 13.8 and `_prListHeadRepo` CRAP 22.4 — both new functions over the threshold of 8, too complex to rescue with coverage alone.
- ⚠️ The two resolvers were near-duplicates already drifting (`nameWithOwner` only in one copy; different branch coverage in each).
- 💡 `_ghBranchExistsRef` sat at exactly CRAP 8.0, and the unreadable-fork-reads-as-dead-head semantics were undocumented.
- No merge conflicts, no other CI failures. The fix is pushed on the PR branch (`ai/gh-1057`, commits `42388320` + `37426a2c`).

## Approach

**One shared head-repo resolver (threads 1–3, single move as suggested):**

- `js/common/smProvider.js`
  - Split the monolithic `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` into three small pieces: `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` (entry: null guard + string dialect + delegate, complexity 6), `_ghRepoShapeFull` (object dialects `full_name` / `nameWithOwner` / owner+name, complexity 5), `_ghRepoOwnerLogin` (`login`/`name` owner resolution, complexity 5).
  - Exported the resolver as `ghPrHeadRepoFull` in the existing `module.exports` block.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js`
  - Deleted the duplicate `_prListHeadRepo`; `_prItemFromPr` now calls `smProviderModule.ghPrHeadRepoFull(p)` through the require that was already at the top of the file (gh-823 hoisting respected — no new/deferred require).

**Thread 4:** `_ghBranchExistsRef` keeps its compact redirect (re-measures at CRAP 8.0, 100% coverage, passing), and its comment block now documents that an unreadable (private) fork reads as a dead head — probe error → absent → benched — matching pre-gh-1057 fork behavior, with the githubSource `catch` only rescuing a throwing oracle.

**Local gate verification** (same pipeline as the CI `crap` job — nyc-instrumented tree, pinned `crap4js@83ee6201`):

```text
_ghPrHeadRepoFull   js/common/smProvider.js   6   100.0%   6.0   (was 13.8)
_ghRepoShapeFull    js/common/smProvider.js   5   100.0%   5.0   (new helper)
_ghRepoOwnerLogin   js/common/smProvider.js   5    75.0%   5.4   (new helper)
_ghBranchExistsRef  js/common/smProvider.js   8   100.0%   8.0   (unchanged, passes)
_prListHeadRepo     — deleted from githubSource.js (was 22.4)
```

## Files Modified

- `js/common/smProvider.js` — resolver split into `_ghPrHeadRepoFull` / `_ghRepoShapeFull` / `_ghRepoOwnerLogin`; `ghPrHeadRepoFull` exported; fail-open doc line on `_ghBranchExistsRef`.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` — `_prListHeadRepo` deleted; `_prItemFromPr` consumes the shared resolver.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smProvider.js` — new dialect-coverage test for the shared resolver (string valid/invalid, `nameWithOwner`, `owner.login`+`name`, `owner.name`, owner-less, name-less, null/headless PR).
- `js/unit-tests/test_smGithubSource.js` — mocks pin the real exported resolver (never a forked copy); new integration test: string and GraphQL `head.repo` spellings ride the item and reach the bench oracle.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js`, `js/unit-tests/test_mergeCadence.js` — smProvider mocks extended with the real `ghPrHeadRepoFull` (they load `githubSource.js`).

## Test Coverage

- TDD: the new `test_smProvider.js` dialect test was RED first (`ghPrHeadRepoFull` unexported → `undefined`), GREEN after the export/split.
- `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` (canonical runner): **4342 passed, 0 failed**.
- Node harness over the nyc-instrumented tree (the coverage vehicle of the `crap` job): **4342 passed, 0 failed**, coverage dumped for the ratchet re-measurement above.
- gh-1057 behavior unchanged: fork redirect, same-repo/malformed fail-safe, deleted-fork null → base probe, throwing-oracle fail-open — all still covered by the pre-existing gh-1057/gh-922 tests (all green).
